excerpts.content:
I couldn't provide an update in the chat yesterday. However, since last week, I have designed and shared the hardened [schema](https://github.com/ethereum/hive/issues/1617) for sign-off. The sole maintainer is busy, so I think I'll go ahead and start implementation before the cohort runs out.

Relating to my first fix, which corrects the fork-choice name mismatch, the issue is also prevalent in Ream. I'm also working on a fix for that and will run the supporting tests to attach to the PR for verification.
